checks.claim: Known affine summaries compose associatively. This checks algebra, not physical parallel execution.
A balanced composition syntax does not itself shorten opaque function evaluation.
A finite polynomial basis with a positive largest degree is not invariant under x->x^2. A four-step expression remains finite. Neither fact decides cheap nonpolynomial transforms.
The inverse reconstructs inputs from available outputs. Forward y2 still consumes actual y1.
A real inverse need not invert a rounded implementation. This is a BF16 RNE toy, not an Ouro collision observation.
Real RMSNorm with positive epsilon and nonzero gains can be invertible on its range. This does not establish full-core or BF16 invertibility.
